description: Defines the QuicReceivedPacketManager class responsible for managing received packets in QUIC protocol implementation, including packet tracking, acknowledgment handling, and related configurations.

classes.name: quic::QuicReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages all received packets for a QUIC connection, including tracking, acknowledgment, and configuration.

methods.name: QuicReceivedPacketManager
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the packet manager.

methods.name: explicit QuicReceivedPacketManager
methods.description: Constructor with a pointer to connection stats.

methods.description: Sets internal state based on configuration.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records a received packet with header, timestamp, and ECN code.

methods.description: Checks if a packet number is missing.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Checks if a packet is still awaited.
